_doc: Built by tools/design/traits/export_traits.py from design/gdd/npc-traits-catalogue.md and design/world/depth/traits-v2.json (NPC Traits #42, Traits v2 amendment 2026-11-25); do not edit by hand. Stat values are in the stat's own units (percent, points or pp, as the key reads them). pulls: the Sects F15 pulls the engine reads; notes: pulls kept as text (event weights and such, read by later systems).

notes: vassal disputes: +2 loyalty to each side
vassal disputes: +5 to one side, −5 to the other (seeded)

upbringing.name: Sect-raised
upbringing.meaning: Taken in as a child; the sect is the only home they know.

upbringing.name: Clan heir
upbringing.meaning: Born into a cultivating clan; resources early, duties always.

upbringing.name: Mortal noble
upbringing.meaning: A lord's or official's child; knows courts, rents and servants.

upbringing.name: Scholar's child
upbringing.meaning: Grew up among books and examinations; reads old script.

upbringing.name: Street orphan
upbringing.meaning: Survived alone in a city's gutters; trusts no one, misses nothing.

upbringing.name: Village-born
upbringing.meaning: Farm or fishing folk; plain, hardy, close to the land.

upbringing.name: Merchant's child
upbringing.meaning: Raised behind a counter; counts in their sleep.

upbringing.name: Temple-raised
upbringing.meaning: Grew up in a monastery or shrine; rites and fasting are second nature.

upbringing.name: Wild-raised
upbringing.meaning: Raised by hunters or beasts in the wilds; reads tracks before letters.

upbringing.name: War orphan
upbringing.meaning: Lost their family to a sect war; remembers whose banner it was.

upbringing.name: Servant-born
upbringing.meaning: Born to the sect's servants; rose from sweeping halls.

upbringing.name: Hermit-taught
upbringing.meaning: Taught alone by a recluse in the mountains; odd habits, deep roots.

talent.name: Quick-minded / Brilliant / Genius
talent.name_vi: thông tuệ / tuệ căn / thiên tài

tiers.world_price: envy ×1.5; rival sects poach them as a disciple ×2

talent.name: Slow / Dim / Dull-witted
talent.name_vi: trì độn / ngu muội / đần độn

talent.name: Sturdy / Robust / Iron-framed
talent.name_vi: tráng kiện / cường tráng / thiết cốt

talent.name: Frail / Sickly / Broken-framed
talent.name_vi: yếu ớt / bệnh nhược / phế cốt

talent.name: Keen / Deep / Vast-souled
talent.name_vi: linh mẫn / thâm hồn / hải hồn
talent.meaning: Soul (thần hồn) gift: senses far, resists the soul arts.

talent.name: Thin / Clouded / Empty-souled
talent.name_vi: hồn bạc / hồn mê / hồn rỗng

talent.name: Comely / Beautiful / Peerless
talent.name_vi: thanh tú / mỹ mạo / khuynh thành

talent.name: Plain / Homely / Scarred-faced
talent.name_vi: tầm thường / xấu xí / mặt sẹo

talent.name: Lucky / Blessed / Fate-touched
talent.name_vi: hữu phúc / phúc hậu / mệnh quý
talent.meaning: Fortune (khí vận) gift; tier 3 overlaps v1 Heaven-favoured and replaces it for new records.

talent.name: Unlucky / Ill-fated / Star-cursed
talent.name_vi: bạc phúc / mệnh khổ / tinh sát
talent.meaning: Fortune flaw; tier 3 overlaps v1 Ill-starred.

talent.name: Steady / Unshaken / Dao-hearted
talent.name_vi: tâm định / tâm kiên / đạo tâm
talent.meaning: Dao heart (đạo tâm) gift: resists heart demons, holds through bottlenecks.

talent.name: Restless / Wavering / Heart-cracked
talent.name_vi: tâm loạn / tâm dao / tâm liệt

path.name: Sword heart
path.meaning: Has become one with the sword; thinks in cuts.

path.name: Pill-fed
path.meaning: Rose on pills more than on work; fast, but the foundation is loose.

path.name: Flawless foundation
path.meaning: Built every stage without a crack; slow and sure.

path.name: Cracked foundation
path.meaning: A rushed or damaged stage left a crack that every breakthrough tests.

path.name: Body-tempered
path.meaning: Has tempered flesh and bone as hard as the art; takes blows others die of.

path.name: Array mind
path.meaning: Sees the world as lines and nodes; lays arrays without thinking.

path.name: Beast-bonded
path.meaning: Shares a life-bond with a spirit beast; feels its hurt.

path.name: Frost-veined
path.meaning: Ice has entered the meridians; cold to the touch, slow to bleed, slow to warm to anyone.

path.name: Fire-tempered
path.meaning: Fire runs hot in them: quick temper, quick pulse, quick hand.

path.name: Lightning-scarred
path.meaning: Survived a lightning strike or a failed tribulation wave; it still hums in them.

path.name: Poison-proofed
path.meaning: Ate poisons for years to build a tolerance; poison is their tool too.

path.name: Deviation survivor
path.meaning: Went through a qi deviation and lived; knows the edge from inside.

path.name: Heart-demon victor
path.meaning: Slew their own heart demon at a breakthrough; calm where others break.

path.name: Long-secluded
path.meaning: Spent decades in closed-door cultivation; deep, out of date, awkward.

path.name: Dual cultivator
path.meaning: Cultivates with a Dao partner; each one's progress feeds the other.

path.name: Demonic path
path.meaning: Cultivates by blood, souls or stolen qi; strong fast, hunted always.

path.name: Buddha's path
path.meaning: Cultivates by vows, abstinence and merit; slow to anger, terrible when roused.

path.name: Tribulation survivor
path.meaning: Faced heaven's lightning and lived (crossing a great gate or surviving a failed wave).

path.name: Awakened bloodline
path.meaning: An ancestor's beast or immortal blood has woken in them.

path.name: Reborn soul
path.meaning: Carries memories of a past life (the world's rebirths); sometimes a stranger looks out of their eyes.

path.name: One-element devotee
path.meaning: Has cultivated a single element to the exclusion of all else.

path.name: Array-bound
path.meaning: Bound to a sect's great array as its keeper; strong inside it, weak far from it.

path.name: Pill-taster
path.meaning: Tastes a pill's flaws on the tongue; has eaten thousands.

path.name: Forge-scarred
path.meaning: Hands burned by a thousand smeltings; feels a blade's grain.

lifestyle.name: Tea master
lifestyle.meaning: Keeps a tea ritual; spirit teas calm the mind.

lifestyle.name: Poet
lifestyle.meaning: Writes verse; their poems travel further than they do.

lifestyle.name: Calligrapher
lifestyle.meaning: Writes a hand that holds intent; talismans come easy.

lifestyle.name: Qin player
lifestyle.meaning: Plays the guqin; their music steadies or unsettles qi.

lifestyle.name: Go player
lifestyle.meaning: Plays weiqi; sees ten moves ahead in politics too.

lifestyle.name: Collector
lifestyle.meaning: Hoards rare treasures, manuals or curios; will trade a favour for one.

lifestyle.name: Gambler
lifestyle.meaning: Bets on stones, duels and fates.

lifestyle.name: Hunter
lifestyle.meaning: Hunts spirit beasts for sport and parts.

lifestyle.name: Gardener
lifestyle.meaning: Tends spirit herbs with love; talks to them.

lifestyle.name: Drinker
lifestyle.meaning: Loves spirit wine more than is wise.

lifestyle.name: Chronicler
lifestyle.meaning: Keeps records of the world's affairs; knows every lineage.

lifestyle.name: Duel-seeker
lifestyle.meaning: Travels to fight the strong; collects defeats as gladly as wins.

lifestyle.name: Born teacher
lifestyle.meaning: Cannot see talent without wanting to shape it.

lifestyle.name: Pilgrim
lifestyle.meaning: Walks to sacred summits and old ruins; never stays long.

health.name: Old wound
health.meaning: A wound that never closed properly; aches before rain.

health.name: Cracked dantian
health.meaning: The dantian is damaged; linh lực leaks.

health.name: Scarred meridians
health.meaning: Meridians scarred by a deviation or a hostile art; arts come slow.

health.name: Lingering poison
health.meaning: A poison no one has cured; it flares in the cold months.

health.name: Cold toxin
health.meaning: Ice-cold qi lodged in the body (often from a failed Ice art).

health.name: Fire poison
health.meaning: Pill fire or forge fire turned inward; feverish, irritable.

health.name: Soul wound
health.meaning: The soul itself is torn; forgets, sees things.

health.name: Maimed
health.meaning: Lost an arm, a leg or an eye; fights differently now.

health.name: Blind
health.meaning: Sightless; divine sense sees for them.

health.name: Waning years
health.meaning: Near the end of their lifespan; desperate for a breakthrough or a legacy.

coping.name: Drowns in wine
coping.meaning: Copes with grief or failure by drinking.

coping.name: Hides in seclusion
coping.meaning: Copes by closing the door and refusing the world.

coping.name: Rage flares
coping.meaning: Copes by lashing out; a slight becomes a duel.

coping.name: Obsessive training
coping.meaning: Copes by training until they bleed.

coping.name: Cold detachment
coping.meaning: Copes by feeling nothing at all; people notice.

coping.name: Vow of vengeance
coping.meaning: Copes by living for one revenge.

coping.name: Found faith
coping.meaning: Copes by turning to a temple's vows.

coping.name: Hoarding
coping.meaning: Copes by gathering stones and pills against a disaster that may come.

opinion._doc: F3 opinion and att0 (design/gdd/npc-traits.md F3, amended 2026-11-25). s, o: shared and opposed weights; like, dislike: v2 likes (+5) and dislikes (-10) for lk; tie: master or disciple, kin, Dao companion, own sect head; sect_same: same sect; sect_k: share of the sects' attitude between NPCs of different sects; k_st: weight of the player's standing; att0_max: ceiling at a first meeting (the floor is the hostile threshold + 1).

choice._doc: F2 choice weight (design/gdd/npc-traits.md F2): the product of the person's trait-by-tag weights is clamped to [m_lo, m_hi]; a 0 weight in the catalogue is F2's never.

inherit._doc: F5 / F5b (design/gdd/npc-traits.md): h, chance per known parent to pass a personality trait; m_master, roll lean toward a master known at creation; talent_one / talent_both, chance to inherit a talent family from 1 or 2 parents; talent_drift, odds for tier shift [-1, 0, +1].

roll._doc: F4 (design/gdd/npc-traits.md F4, amended 2026-11-25): p_any (0.04) is the chance of a kept fate-given trait and p_second (0.10) of a second given the first (0.96 / 0.036 / 0.004); g_f = clamp(talent / g_ref, g_lo, g_hi) for a gift, the inverse for a flaw, on the talent before trait rows.

roll_v2._doc: F4b creation roll and F6b coping/waning constants (design/gdd/npc-traits.md F4b, F6b, Tuning Knobs).
